description: Evidence-scoped reusable capabilities for controlled CNC output variation.

execution_limits: never guess axis count
use only controller-reported axes
retain aggregate read if discovery fails
observable_results: successful aggregate and per-axis input combinations

execution_limits: never guess values
failed calls do not count as variation
no CNC system-parameter writes
no guessed addresses
explicit permission and rollback plan required
do not create/delete programs unless explicitly authorized
no automatic cleanup
no guessed O-number

preconditions: controller-supported DNC/M198 option and applicable mode
for M198: confirmed resident program, optionally prepared by a legal download session
isolated NCGuide execution permission and bounded NC text when activation is attempted
execution_limits: cnc_dncstart2 only observes an already active DNC/M198 operation
uploading a program does not by itself start DNC/M198
never write CNC parameters or inject PMC signals
pause for operator mode/selection/Cycle Start when activation gates are unverified
call cnc_dnc2/cnc_dncend2 only after cnc_dncstart2 returns EW_OK and ownership is confirmed
observable_results: EW_OK with filename/program request when DNC/M198 is active
EW_REJECT when no DNC/M198 operation is active
actual upload session and directory evidence for a prepared M198 program
matched DNC data/end traffic only for an owned successful session

preconditions: validated NC syntax and motion bounds
execution_limits: no real-machine motion
no automatic or operator Cycle Start until isolation, permission, and motion bounds are verified
single-block and bounds checks

tools_or_apis: operator Cycle Start after all gates pass
execution_limits: do not write PMC/system parameters
do not guess signal injection
plan-only until isolation, permission, and motion bounds are verified
when gates pass, explicitly prompt operator to press Cycle Start
observation does not prove a state transition
